name: Paz Vega
bio: Paz Campos Trigo (born January 2, 1976), better known as Paz Vega, is a Spanish actress. She became popular for her performance in the comedy television series, 7 Vidas. Her notable film credits include Sex and Lucia (2001), Spanglish (2004), and Rambo: Last Blood (2019)
